questions.q: What is the scientific definition of work done when a force moves an object?
a: Energy transferred when a force moves an object through a distance
The total mass of the object lifted
The speed at which a machine operates
The amount of heat generated by friction

questions.q: What is the formula used to calculate work done?
a: Work = Force multiplied by Distance moved in the direction of the force
Work = Power multiplied by Time squared

a: The work done drops to zero

questions.q: Which of the following formulas is used to calculate power?
a: Power = Work done (or energy transferred) divided by Time taken
